notes: More motion across the app: screens and menus glide in and out, cards arrive one after another and lift when you point at them, a world's cast fans out on hover, buttons press in with a ripple, and bouncing dots show while the AI is starting a reply.
Characters who are busy living an off-screen moment have a breathing dot, the phone badge bumps when something new comes in, and notices slide away instead of blinking out.
Prefer stillness? Settings has a new Interface animations option: Calm turns it all off.
Fixed: a new story no longer shows a stray "Show earlier messages" button.
